description: Java class implementing an external rule node for publishing messages to AWS SQS in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbSqsNode
classes.description: Java class for AWS SQS external rule node in Thingsboard, handling message publishing and metadata processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, sets up AWS credentials and SQS client.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, triggers asynchronous message publishing.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Builds and sends the message to AWS SQS, processes the result.

methods.name: processSendMessageResult
methods.description: Updates message metadata with AWS response details.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during message processing, updates metadata with error info.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the SQS client during node destruction.
